integration: Explicit native-engine adaptations for the committed trio base models, not proposal parity. Uses existing hitscan, melee and ability IDs/FX. No whip physics, chess summons, reflection, refraction or new movement/collision rules. Baselines are budgeted against existing kits; human match balance is unverified.

heroes.name: Spoollash
heroes.lore: A cable-reel creature. Slow one target, pull yourself forward and cut a short cone.

abilities.name: Snagline
abilities.description: Hit one visible enemy and slow it by 35% for up to two seconds. Cover or 16m separation breaks the tether.

abilities.name: Reel In
abilities.description: Pull yourself toward the first enemy or solid wall within 18m. Movement still collides; this does not pull enemies.

abilities.name: Crosscut
abilities.description: Instantly hit each visible enemy once in a short cone. No whip contact damage or projectile simulation.

abilities.name: Free Spool
abilities.description: Move 35% faster for 2.4 seconds. No invulnerability; normal collision applies.

heroes.name: Checkmate Regent
heroes.lore: A porcelain sovereign. Place cover, slow nearby enemies and fire a precision sceptre shot.

abilities.name: Rank Guard
abilities.description: Place the existing solid filing barricade ahead for four seconds. The wrist guard itself is cosmetic.

abilities.name: Royal Decree
abilities.description: Damage and slow enemies within 5m, blocked by solid cover.

abilities.name: Rook Line
abilities.description: Fire one hitscan precision shot up to 40m. Head hits use the weapon multiplier; walls stop it.

abilities.name: Castle Guard
abilities.description: Become invulnerable and move 15% faster for 1.2 seconds. No reflection or chess-piece summons.

heroes.name: Prism Warden
heroes.lore: A survey guardian. Reveal nearby enemies, empower headshots and lob a fused area blast.

abilities.name: Sightline
abilities.description: Fire one hitscan precision shot up to 72m. Head hits use the weapon multiplier; no piercing or refraction.

abilities.name: Optic Census
abilities.description: Reveal live enemies within 40m through cover for three seconds. Shots still stop at walls.

abilities.name: Fine Focus
abilities.description: For four seconds, weapon and precision-shot head hits use a 2.2x multiplier. Body hits are unchanged.

abilities.name: Prism Charge
abilities.description: Lob a bouncing charge with a 1.6-second fuse and 4m blast radius. Solid cover blocks the blast.
